title: T3 co-owner sign-off records
description: The file that --allow-t3 is checked against: --t3-signoff-file PATH, else SHOWCASE_T3_SIGNOFF_FILE, else <estate root>/decisions/t3-signoffs.yaml. The tool also rejects an approved_on later than today and an expires earlier than approved_on, which a schema cannot state. Dates are written as YAML dates or ISO 8601 strings; validate after converting YAML dates to ISO strings. See references/t3-signoff.md.

id.description: Carried onto writer jobs and change records as signoff_id.

owner.description: Any login of the T3 org; renamed logins resolve through its aliases.

repos.description: "*" for every repository and owner-wide actions, or repository names / OWNER/NAME.

approved.description: Only true grants; false is kept for the audit trail.

expires.description: A date (valid through that day) or a timestamp with a UTC offset (valid before that instant).
